scope: Additional retrospective audit. All calibration and evaluation outcomes were previously analyzed. This protocol locks the present analysis but creates no new independent confirmation. No model fit or external retail reopening.

choice.thresholds: largest whole-tie feasible threshold; explicit accept-all; original common cap constraints in both M5 calibration windows, original .95*cap margin on Bike calibration
choice.empty: no selected policy; reject all; undefined accepted risk

separate_screen.scope: M5 primary cap only, approximate item bootstrap; random item resampling does not account for shared store/calendar shocks
separate_screen.threshold_design: calibration A only at 0.95*primary_cap; row floor .35; common finite family, all 3 predictors times 5 rankings
separate_screen.risk_screen: calibration B one-sided bootstrap upper bound of signed excess per item <=0, Bonferroni .05/15 across all 15 fixed candidates; positive realized accepted exposure
separate_screen.selection: among screen-passing candidates for each predictor, maximize case or exposure coverage on calibration A
separate_screen.test: Later outcomes only evaluate frozen selections; no retuning if failure

inference.unit_m5: item, all stores and days retained
inference.main_contrasts: exposure-choice minus case-choice at existing primary cap for 3 M5 backbones and Bike; 8 coverage endpoints total
inference.coverage_intervals: 95% descriptive and Bonferroni 99.375% for 8 primary coverage endpoints; conditional on fitted models and chosen policies; not selection uncertainty
inference.risk_intervals: pointwise 95% descriptive test risk intervals; do not infer population feasibility from point estimates
inference.sensitivity: all declared caps; no post-hoc winner promotion

planned_outputs: all calibration metrics, frozen choices and hashes
all test metrics including no-choice conditions
retrospective split calibration screens including all rejected candidates
